description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ContactAccessor' that provides an SDK-independent API for communicating with the Contacts provider on Android devices. It includes logic to determine and instantiate the appropriate SDK-specific implementation based on the device's API level, as well as abstract methods for getting a contact picker intent and loading contact data from a URI.

classes.name: ContactAccessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing an SDK-independent interface for contact data access, with methods to get a contact pick intent and load contact details.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of a concrete implementation of ContactAccessor based on the device's SDK version.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain an Intent for picking a contact; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Abstract method to load contact data given a content resolver and URI; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the appropriate SDK-specific subclass of ContactAccessor, instantiated dynamically based on device SDK level.
